label: Chapter 57
english: Two in number are the soul’s peaceful states: [A] the first arises from natural seeds; [B] while the other is engendered by the withdrawal of the demons [A] From the first there follow:
[2] pride, which capture the monk when the other demons go away.
One who perceives the beginnings of the first [peaceful] state will be even more sharply aware of the attacks of the demons.
